:root { font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(23, 43, 64); background: rgb(240, 243, 247); --ink: #172b40; --muted: #52657a; --line: #d8e1eb; --blue: #194f82; --teal: #176654; --amber: #805013; --red: #973837; --purple: #62408b; font-synthesis: none; }
header, footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 20px; }
header { background: rgb(19, 44, 70); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 20px max(24px, -660px + 50vw); border-bottom: 3px solid rgb(107, 174, 177); }
.brand small { display: block; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.45px; margin-top: 5px; color: rgb(184, 203, 220); }

.mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgb(37, 85, 112); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 9px 12px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 650; border: 1px solid rgb(76, 122, 145); border-radius: 8px; }

.badge, .tag, .state-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 5px; border: 1px solid rgb(199, 215, 232); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.4px; background: rgb(234, 242, 251); color: var(--blue); }
header .badge { color: rgb(229, 241, 255); background: rgb(35, 67, 94); border-color: rgb(85, 112, 136); }
header .badge[data-state="replay"] { color: rgb(240, 231, 255); background: rgb(73, 54, 98); border-color: rgb(128, 101, 158); }
header .badge[data-state="test"] { color: rgb(255, 237, 200); background: rgb(104, 78, 36); border-color: rgb(161, 124, 62); }
.tag { font-size: 10px; color: var(--muted); background: rgb(245, 247, 250); border-color: var(--line); }
[data-state="review"], [data-state="deferred"], [data-state="overridden"], [data-state="low"] { color: var(--amber); background: rgb(255, 244, 223); border-color: rgb(233, 206, 152); }
[data-state="approved"] { color: var(--teal); background: rgb(234, 245, 239); border-color: rgb(183, 213, 199); }
[data-state="error"], [data-state="rejected"], [data-state="unavailable"] { color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 240, 238); border-color: rgb(232, 190, 186); }
[data-state="draft"], [data-state="replay"] { color: var(--purple); background: rgb(243, 237, 250); border-color: rgb(217, 201, 237); }
[data-state="excluded"] { color: var(--muted); background: rgb(240, 243, 247); border-color: var(--line); }
.eyebrow { color: var(--blue); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0px 0px 8px; }
h1 { font-size: clamp(27px, 3vw, 36px); line-height: 1.18; letter-spacing: -1px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0px 0px 8px; }

.prototype { padding: 11px 14px; border-width: 1px 1px 1px 3px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(220, 207, 174) rgb(220, 207, 174) rgb(220, 207, 174) rgb(173, 134, 63); border-image: none; border-radius: 5px; color: rgb(97, 79, 45); background: rgb(255, 250, 240); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; }

.context-bar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1.25fr 1.15fr 1fr; border-right: 1px solid rgb(203, 216, 230); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(203, 216, 230); border-left: 1px solid rgb(203, 216, 230); border-image: none; border-top: 3px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); margin: 20px 0px 0px; }
.context-bar > div { padding: 16px 18px; min-width: 0px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); }
.context-label { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.85px; font-weight: 650; margin-bottom: 7px; }
.context-bar strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.context-bar small { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.section-nav { display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 0px 18px; }
.section-nav a { text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; border-radius: 5px; }

.card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 23px; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: rgba(25, 61, 96, 0.02) 0px 2px 3px; min-width: 0px; scroll-margin-top: 18px; }
h2 { font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; margin: 0px 0px 18px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.25px; }

h2 > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 25px; height: 25px; margin-right: 9px; color: var(--blue); background: rgb(237, 243, 250); border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px; vertical-align: middle; letter-spacing: 0px; }
.section-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 19px; }
.grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: start; }
form { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: end; }
label { display: grid; gap: 7px; flex: 1 1 190px; min-width: 0px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; color: var(--muted); }

input, select, textarea { width: 100%; min-width: 0px; font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; font-size: 15px; padding: 11px 12px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid rgb(189, 204, 220); background: rgb(251, 252, 254); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--ink); }
input:disabled, select:disabled { background: rgb(239, 243, 247); color: var(--muted); }
.check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; flex: 1 1 100%; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink); }
.check input { width: 18px; height: 18px; min-height: 18px; accent-color: var(--blue); }

button { font-style: inherit; font-variant: inherit; font-stretch: inherit; font-family: inherit; font-optical-sizing: inherit; font-size-adjust: inherit; font-kerning: inherit; font-feature-settings: inherit; font-variation-settings: inherit; font-language-override: inherit; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; padding: 11px 17px; background: var(--blue); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; }
button:disabled { color: rgb(82, 101, 122); background: rgb(230, 237, 244); border-color: rgb(210, 220, 230); cursor: not-allowed; }

button[aria-busy="true"]::before, #status[data-state="busy"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; flex: 0 0 14px; border-width: 2px; border-style: solid; border-right-color: rgb(168, 190, 212); border-bottom-color: rgb(168, 190, 212); border-left-color: rgb(168, 190, 212); border-image: none; border-top-color: var(--blue); border-radius: 50%; animation: 0.8s linear 0s infinite normal none running spin; }
.quiet, .secondary { color: var(--blue); background: rgb(237, 243, 250); border-color: rgb(208, 221, 235); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline: rgb(52, 122, 185) solid 3px; outline-offset: 3px; }
.skip-link { position: absolute; top: -80px; left: 20px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 12px 16px; z-index: 10; }
.placeholder { padding: 18px; border: 1px dashed rgb(200, 213, 227); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(248, 250, 252); }
p { font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 10px 0px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
details { margin-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 6px; }
summary { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 0px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--blue); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; }
.datum { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 15px; padding: 9px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(237, 241, 246); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.datum strong { text-align: right; font-weight: 600; overflow-wrap: anywhere; min-width: 0px; }
.datum small { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; margin-top: 3px; }
.source-heading { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.source-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 8px; }

.alert-item { margin-top: 17px; padding: 15px; background: rgb(255, 250, 241); border-width: 1px 1px 1px 3px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgb(231, 213, 175) rgb(231, 213, 175) rgb(231, 213, 175) rgb(179, 123, 46); border-image: none; border-radius: 5px; }
.alert-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 10px 0px; }
.alert-meta span { font-size: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(229, 210, 170); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 7px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(115, 82, 30); }

.recommendation { background: rgb(243, 247, 252); border-top: 1px solid rgb(211, 224, 238); border-right: 1px solid rgb(211, 224, 238); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(211, 224, 238); border-image: none; border-left: 4px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 6px; padding: 17px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.recommendation-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 650; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.9px; }
.big-posture { font-size: 29px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.7px; font-weight: 650; margin: 7px 0px 12px; color: var(--ink); }
.warning, .review-note { padding: 12px 14px; border-left: 3px solid rgb(182, 138, 67); background: rgb(255, 248, 233); border-radius: 3px; color: rgb(114, 82, 30); font-size: 12px; }
.rule-card { background: rgb(248, 250, 252); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; padding: 14px; margin: 15px 0px; }

.recorded-decision { border-top: 1px solid rgb(188, 214, 205); border-right: 1px solid rgb(188, 214, 205); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(188, 214, 205); border-image: none; border-left: 4px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(245, 250, 248); padding: 16px; margin: 19px 0px 0px; }
.recorded-decision[data-state="overridden"] { border-color: rgb(224, 207, 171) rgb(224, 207, 171) rgb(224, 207, 171) rgb(173, 124, 43); background: rgb(255, 250, 240); color: var(--ink); }

.recorded-decision[data-state="rejected"] { border-top-color: rgb(226, 189, 184); border-right-color: rgb(226, 189, 184); border-bottom-color: rgb(226, 189, 184); border-left-color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 246, 244); color: var(--ink); }
.draft-notice { padding: 11px 14px; color: var(--purple); border: 1px solid rgb(223, 211, 237); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(248, 244, 252); margin: 0px 0px 18px; font-size: 12px; }
#people:not(.placeholder) { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
.person { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; min-width: 0px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.person-top { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
.person-meta { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 10px 0px; }
.person-meta > span:not(.state-pill) { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(242, 245, 249); }
.follow-up { padding: 10px; background: rgb(255, 247, 231); border-radius: 4px; color: rgb(114, 82, 30); }
.message { white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; padding: 12px; background: rgb(245, 247, 250); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

#status:not(:empty) { display: flex; align-items: start; gap: 11px; padding: 12px 15px; background: rgb(234, 242, 251); border: 1px solid rgb(199, 217, 238); border-radius: 5px; color: rgb(36, 83, 126); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 18px; }
#status.error { color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 240, 238); border-color: rgb(227, 187, 181); }
a { color: var(--blue); font-size: 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.history-row { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 14px 0px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.history-row p { flex: 1 1 0%; margin: 0px; font-size: 12px; white-space: pre-line; }
#exports { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; }

#exports a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(198, 214, 231); border-radius: 5px; background: rgb(243, 247, 252); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; }
footer { max-width: 1368px; margin: auto; padding: 19px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); align-items: start; }

.next-step { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(188, 208, 228); border-right: 1px solid rgb(188, 208, 228); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(188, 208, 228); border-image: none; border-left: 4px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 7px; background: rgb(234, 242, 251); padding: 18px 20px; margin-top: 18px; }
.next-step p { font-size: 13px; margin: 0px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 850px; }

.guide-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; background: var(--blue); border-radius: 5px; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; }
.workflow-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0px, 1fr)); gap: 9px; margin: 16px 0px 10px; }

.workflow-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 64px; }
.workflow-nav b { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 27px; height: 27px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgb(231, 237, 244); color: var(--muted); }
.workflow-nav small { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; margin-top: 4px; }
.workflow-nav a[data-state="current"] b { background: var(--blue); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.record-links { display: flex; gap: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0px 0px 18px; }
.record-links a { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
.work-hours-refresh { grid-column: 1 / -1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
header { background: rgb(35, 72, 102); padding: 14px max(24px, -660px + 50vw); border-bottom: 0px; min-height: 72px; }
.badge, .tag, .state-pill { border-radius: 2px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; padding: 3px 7px; background: rgb(239, 243, 246); border-color: rgb(201, 212, 221); color: var(--blue); }
header .badge, header .badge[data-state="replay"] { background: transparent; border-color: rgb(139, 165, 185); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
header .badge[data-state="test"] { background: rgb(255, 244, 232); color: rgb(141, 56, 6); border-color: rgb(255, 244, 232); }
[data-state="review"], [data-state="deferred"], [data-state="overridden"], [data-state="low"] { color: var(--amber); background: rgb(255, 244, 232); border-color: rgb(230, 197, 170); }
[data-state="approved"] { color: var(--teal); background: rgb(237, 245, 240); border-color: rgb(184, 208, 194); }
[data-state="error"], [data-state="rejected"], [data-state="unavailable"] { color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 241, 239); border-color: rgb(222, 180, 175); }
[data-state="draft"], [data-state="replay"] { color: var(--blue); background: rgb(239, 243, 246); border-color: rgb(201, 212, 221); }
[data-state="excluded"] { color: var(--muted); background: rgb(245, 246, 247); border-color: var(--line); }

.prototype { border-top: 0px; border-right: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-image: none; border-left: 2px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(101, 65, 43); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }
.context-bar { order: -1; margin: 0px 0px 12px; border-radius: 2px; border-top: 2px solid var(--blue); grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1.35fr 1.15fr 1fr; }

.next-step { margin: 0px; border-top: 0px; border-right: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-image: none; border-left: 2px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 0px; background: rgb(239, 243, 246); padding: 12px 15px; gap: 16px; }

.guide-action { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: var(--blue); border: 1px solid rgb(168, 185, 199); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 12px; padding: 9px 12px; min-height: 44px; white-space: normal; flex-shrink: 0; max-width: 240px; }
.workflow-nav { gap: 0px; margin: 12px 0px 0px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }

.workflow-nav a { background: transparent; border-top: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-left: 0px; border-image: none; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 54px; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; }
.workflow-nav b { height: auto; flex-basis: 15px; background: transparent; border-radius: 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.workflow-nav a[data-state="current"] { background: rgb(233, 239, 243); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--blue); }
.workflow-nav a[data-state="current"] b { background: transparent; color: var(--blue); }
.card { border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: none; padding: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px; scroll-margin-top: 16px; }
h2 > span { width: auto; height: auto; margin-right: 8px; background: transparent; border-radius: 0px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
input, select, textarea { border-color: rgb(174, 185, 194); border-radius: 2px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 10px 11px; }
input:disabled, select:disabled { background: rgb(240, 242, 244); color: var(--muted); }
#evaluate button { grid-column: auto; justify-self: start; color: var(--blue); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: var(--blue); }
#evaluate button:disabled { color: var(--muted); background: rgb(232, 236, 239); border-color: rgb(203, 211, 218); }
button { border-radius: 2px; transition: none; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--blue); font-size: 13px; }
button:disabled { color: var(--muted); background: rgb(232, 236, 239); border-color: rgb(203, 211, 218); }
.quiet, .secondary { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: rgb(188, 200, 209); color: var(--blue); }
.placeholder { background: rgb(245, 246, 247); border-radius: 2px; border-color: rgb(186, 197, 206); padding: 14px; }
input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, summary:focus-visible, a:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--blue); }

.alert-item { margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-top-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-right-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-bottom-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-left: 3px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0px; }
.alert-meta span { border: 0px; border-radius: 0px; padding: 0px; background: transparent; color: rgb(120, 81, 47); font-size: 11px; }
.alert-meta span + span { border-left: 1px solid rgb(216, 196, 179); padding-left: 8px; }

.recommendation { background: rgb(239, 243, 246); border-top-color: rgb(201, 212, 221); border-right-color: rgb(201, 212, 221); border-bottom-color: rgb(201, 212, 221); border-left: 3px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 0px; padding: 15px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.recorded-decision[data-state="overridden"] { border-top-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-right-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-bottom-color: rgb(224, 201, 184); border-left-color: var(--amber); background: rgb(255, 247, 239); }

.recorded-decision[data-state="rejected"] { border-top-color: rgb(222, 180, 175); border-right-color: rgb(222, 180, 175); border-bottom-color: rgb(222, 180, 175); border-left-color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 241, 239); }

.draft-notice { color: var(--blue); background: rgb(239, 243, 246); border-top: 0px; border-right: 0px; border-bottom: 0px; border-image: none; border-left: 2px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 0px; padding: 10px 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }

.person { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 0.95fr) minmax(0px, 2fr); gap: 0px 24px; border-top: 0px; border-right: 0px; border-left: 0px; border-image: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0px; padding: 14px 0px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); }
.person-top { grid-column: 1; align-items: start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.person-meta > span:not(.state-pill) { padding: 0px; background: transparent; border-radius: 0px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }

#status.error { color: var(--red); background: rgb(255, 241, 239); border-color: rgb(222, 180, 175); }
.history-row button { color: var(--blue); background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-color: rgb(188, 200, 209); }
